description: Defines the HttpServer class and its delegate, including methods for handling HTTP and WebSocket connections, sending responses, and managing connections within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpServer
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP server capable of handling HTTP and WebSocket connections, sending responses, and managing network I/O.

classes.name: HttpServer::Delegate
classes.description: An interface for handling events such as new connections, requests, messages, and disconnections.

methods.name: HttpServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server with a socket and delegate.

methods.name: AcceptWebSocket
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection with given request info.

methods.name: SendOverWebSocket
methods.description: Sends data over an established WebSocket connection.

methods.name: SendRaw
methods.description: Sends raw data directly to a connection without validation.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response to a connection.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response with status code, data, and MIME type.

methods.name: Send500
methods.description: Sends a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for a connection.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for a connection.

methods.name: GetLocalInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local interface address, considering IPADDR_ANY.

methods.name: ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses HTTP headers from a request string.
